Hi Ava — great to hear and thanks for the profile. High level answers below (quick reference for procurement / MAP):

Summary table (pilot assumptions):
- Model: rwd-open-7B-fp16 (default) | Avg tokens/interaction: 520 (prompt 120 / gen 400) | Tokens per 1M: 1,000,000 | Cost estimate @ hosted rates: ~$420 per 1M tokens (estimate)
- Model: rwd-open-7B-4bit (quantized) | Avg tokens/interaction: 520 | Cost estimate @ quantized path: ~$210 per 1M tokens (savings ~50%)

Caching & batching assumptions (what we used to produce above):
- KV/prefix cache hit-rate: 40% baseline (matches your note). Effective tokens charged = tokens * (1 - cache_hit).
- Batching policy: continuous batching with a 10ms micro-window + opportunistic coalescing up to 32 requests per GPU seq-run. Typical added latency: median +5ms, p95 +30–40ms under pilot traffic mix.
- Prefetch recommendation: warm top-50 prompts on session open; reduces cold-start token overhead by ~12% for chat flows.

Pilot cost range (100k MAU, conservative active sessions):
- Assumes 100k MAU, 2 interactions/user/day, avg 520 tokens/interaction => ~104M tokens/month.
- Hosted fp16 path: ~104 * $0.00042 per 1k tokens => roughly $43k/month. (we'll provide a formal spreadsheet if helpful)
- Quantized 4-bit path: ~ $21–22k/month.

MAP milestones (proposed):
1) Evaluation start (Week 0): baseline integration + traffic replay (2 weeks). Success metric: integration + replay pass, <10% error rate from model responses.
2) Cost/ops validation (Week 2–4): run pilot at 10% traffic, confirm token counts and cache hit-rate >= 35%. Success metric: actual tokens/month within ±15% of estimate; p95 latency <300ms.
3) Go/no-go decision (Week 4): Ops & procurement signoff. If unit-costs or SLAs materially deviate, we pivot to quantized model + batching tweaks.

Next steps: can you confirm a daytime window for the integration kickoff? I can loop in Karthik and Laura for technical and commercial alignment.

Best,

Jordan / Laura — quick technical validation and a correction to the external table:

1) Token-charged math (explicit):
- Raw_tokens = observed prompt + gen tokens per interaction.
- Charged_tokens = Raw_tokens * (1 - cache_hit_rate) + metadata/overhead (we assume ~2% overhead for framing).
Example: 520 raw * (1 - 0.40) = 312 charged; add 2% => ~318 charged tokens per interaction.

2) Sensitivity to 200M tokens/mo:
- At 200M tokens/mo, fp16 hosted path => ~200 * $0.00042 per 1k => ~$84k/mo. Quantized 4-bit => ~$42k/mo.
- If heavy sessions push gen -> 900 tokens avg, adjust charged tokens accordingly (900 * (1 - 0.40) ~ 540 -> +2% overhead = 551 charged). That increases monthly burn to ~110–115% of baseline.

3) Batching/latency trade:
- Increasing micro-window to 30ms raises typical p95 by ~15–20ms on top of previous numbers, but allows higher coalescing and lower per-token kernel overhead. For CardioNova profile I estimate net per-token cost reduction ~8–10% with 30ms window vs 10ms.

4) SLA crediting (pilot):
- Proposed pilot SLA credit: if p95 latency > 300ms for >6 hours in aggregated daily windows across region for 3 or more business days during pilot, we offer a one-time credit equal to 10% of that pilot month's invoice. (this is temporary for pilot only).

5) Cache milestone measurement:
- We'll instrument and publish a daily cache_hit_rate metric in the console. Official measurement window: 28-day rolling average during pilot. Threshold for credit: >=40% rolling.

I can produce a short one-pager with the math and a sample spreadsheet. Jordan — if you want, I can attach that and send back to Ava.
